answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, slashed on a failed audit, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the quill of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sparrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the ferrous is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
